pins.name: D4
pins.label: GPIO4 (Led Neopixel)
pins.notes: PIN_NEOPIXEL — onboard single status NeoPixel (WS2812), output-only data line, active-high. Confirmed via Adafruit's own learn.adafruit.com pinouts guide, CircuitPython pins.c (D4/NEOPIXEL -> GPIO4), and Zephyr's adafruit_feather_rfm95_rp2040.dts onboard ws2812 node (gpios = <&gpio0 4 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>).

pins.name: D7
pins.label: GPIO7 (Button)
pins.notes: PIN_BUTTON / BOOT — onboard bootloader-select pushbutton, also usable as a general input when application code is running. Active-low with the RP2040's internal pull-up enabled (no external pull-up on this line). Confirmed via Zephyr's adafruit_feather_rfm95_rp2040.dts gpio_keys node (gpios = <&gpio0 7 (GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW | GPIO_PULL_UP)>) and Adafruit's own pinouts guide ("BOOT... connected to GPIO7 and available as... PIN_BUTTON in Arduino"). Full digital_input/digital_output/pwm_output capability retained (ordinary GPIO wired to a switch to GND, not a dedicated/capacitive-only pin), matching this repo's adafruit_feather_scorpio/vccgnd_yd_rp2040 PIN_BUTTON/PIN_USRKEY precedent.

pins.name: D13
pins.label: GPIO13 (Led active high)
pins.notes: PIN_LED — onboard status LED, active-high. Confirmed via Zephyr's adafruit_feather_rfm95_rp2040.dts leds node (gpios = <&gpio0 13 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>), consistent with Adafruit's own pinouts guide describing it as controllable via PIN_LED/board.LED. digital_input dropped to match this repo's established led_high precedent for dedicated onboard LED pins (rpipico, adafruit_feather_scorpio, challenger_2040_lora); pwm_output kept since arduino-pico's analogWrite() works on any RP2040 GPIO, enabling brightness dimming. This GPIO was also the vendor's default (unused) PIN_SPI0_SS alias, which would have contaminated this confirmed LED tag with a spurious spi_ss capability — fixed 2026-07-13 by removing that alias (and its dependent SS static-const) from pins_arduino.h (no onboard SPI device consumes it as SS; the RFM radio's chip-select is the separate dedicated GPIO16 PIN_RFM_CS line), matching the adafruit_feather_scorpio precedent.
